title: Cutoff-Uniform Enstrophy Bounds, Fractional Riccati Integrability Thresholds, and Resonant-Triad Depletion in Dyadic and Toroidal Fluid Hierarchies: A Machine-Checked Investigation of Ten Frontier Hypotheses (Revised Edition v2.1)
description:
We conduct a systematic, machine-checked mathematical physics investigation of ten hypotheses governing enstrophy production, fractional hyperviscous regularity thresholds, dispersive second-harmonic-generation (SHG) regulators, and three-dimensional resonant-triad hypergraph depletion across the Katz–Pavlović dyadic hierarchy and toroidal Fourier lattices. Six of the ten hypotheses are proved and four are refuted or obstructed by explicit counterexamples, integrability deficits, and arithmetic parity theorems; three of the ten (H2b, H8, H9b) are elementary controls.

In this revised edition (v2.1, responding to an external review of the first edition): (i) we prove the general ratio-r inter-shell scaling identity (anomalous prefactor r2 − 1) and the dyadic cubic enstrophy production bound SN2 ≤ 2ΩN3 and the exact shifted-flux identity ∑ kn2 an+12 + (1/4)k02 a02 = (1/2)ΩN (saturating (1/2)ΩN whenever a0=0), along with the explicit non-geometric witness kn = n+1 giving net production ∑(prodInn - prodOutn) = -1 - 4 + 18 = 13 ≠ 27; (ii) we establish the Cheskidov fractional Riccati exponent identity s(α) - 1 = 1/ρ(α) with Young absorption for α > 1/3 and the integrability threshold ρ(α) ≥ 1 ⇔ α ≥ 1/2 and prove on the unit energy sphere 2E1 = a02 + a12 = 1 via the Pythagorean positive-cone wavepacket (a0, a1) = (15/17, 8/17) that single-step coercive damping holds at ν = 1 (3S1 - D1/2,1 = -7129/4913 < 0) while instantaneous enstrophy growth occurs at supercritical Reynolds number Re = 1/ν = 3 (3S1 - (1/3)D1/2,1 = +3671/14739 > 0); (iii) we prove the σ = 3 graded Hamiltonian bound 2DΩN+1 ≤ Hσ=3 + M∞ S for the complexified SHG dispersive regulator; and (iv) we establish the closed-form 2-section spectrum Spec(A) = {6n-8, -8, -4} and normalized Laplacian spectrum Spec(Lnorm) = {0, 6n/(6n-8), (6n-4)/(6n-8)} on the 3D resonant-triad hypergraph, together with a complete exact audit on the closed Euclidean ball Λ6 = {k ∈ Z3 \ {0} : 0 < |k|2 ≤ 36} (|Λ6| = 924, |T(Λ6)| = 398,190) proving why perfect-square shells |k|2 = m2 suffer collinear axis enrichment (D = 1.3305 > 1) while prime norm-square shells |k|2 ∈ P achieve genuine nonlinear triad depletion (D = 0.5716 < 1, 98.73% cross-scale triads) and odd norm-square shells achieve total parity amputation (D = 0). All 19 Lean 4 declarations are verified with zero sorryAx axioms against a frozen canonical specification.

Edition history: first edition 10.5281/zenodo.23458238; v2.0 10.5281/zenodo.23459268 (deposited as a separate record by mistake). This v2.1 corrects the v2.0 description (which stated a threshold alpha* = 1/4, a bound 2D Omega ≤ 2H_3 and an adjacency spectrum containing 0, none of which appear in the paper), withdraws the scripted 'peer review report' distributed with v2.0 (generated text with invented referee personas and scores, not a review), and adds a response to the external review of the first edition. The numbers in the manuscript are checked against the exact harness by the build.
notes: Revised Edition v2.1 (response to an external review). Includes the Lean 4 proof artifacts, the exact rational/integer verification datasets, the 5-tier Elenchus ledger, and a machine-check consistency report (CONSISTENCY_REPORT.md). The v2.0 'peer review report' is withdrawn.
